newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $11.1 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $11.1 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The central Bank of Mauritius sold 228.1 million rupees ($11.1 million) of treasury bills at its weekly auction out of 325 million rupees put on tender, the bank said on Thursday.

The bank said it sold 90.6 million rupees of 91-day, 61.5 million rupees of 182-day and 76.0 million rupees of 364-day bills with average weighted yields of 9.53 percent, 9.47 percent and 9.69 percent respectively.
It said the week's effective bank rate had been posted at 9.82 percent per annum from 9.67 percent last week.
Last week, the bank sold 868.5 million rupees of 91-, 182- and 364-day treasury bills with weighted yields of 9.32 percent, 9.36 percent and 9.57 percent respectively.
